# Compoxen

> Compoxen is a Utah composite fence supply store and professional installer.
> We manufacture mineral-reinforced polymer composite fence panels and install
> them across the entire state of Utah. Every product carries a 20-year
> material warranty, requires zero maintenance, and ships in five architect-led
> colors (Harbor Slate, Mesa Taupe, Shadow Forge, Redwood Ember, Cocoa Ridge).
> Compoxen is headquartered in Draper, Utah and serves all 8 metro Utah counties:
> Salt Lake, Utah, Davis, Weber, Tooele, Wasatch, Summit, and Cache.
